pages.title: Introduction
pages.lead: Custom elements. Native behavior. Nearly no JavaScript.

pages.title: Tokens & theming
pages.lead: Knobs → scales → roles. Theming is swapping token values, never overriding component CSS.

pages.title: Preset
pages.lead: Constructive defaults: raw HTML should look finished, not like nothing.

pages.title: Accessibility
pages.lead: Native semantics first; script only where access requires it.

pages.title: vstack
pages.lead: Vertical flow with consistent gaps. The workhorse.

pages.title: hstack
pages.lead: One horizontal row. Wrapping is opt-in, per the name's promise.

pages.title: zstack
pages.lead: Layering: children share one grid cell. Paint order is DOM order.

pages.title: center
pages.lead: Intrinsic horizontal centering with a readable measure.

pages.title: box
pages.lead: Padding; an inside for content.

pages.title: grid
pages.lead: Responsive grid with zero media queries.

pages.title: sidecar
pages.lead: A fixed + flexible pair that stacks when narrow. This page's shell uses it.

pages.title: switcher
pages.lead: A row that switches to a column below a width threshold.

pages.title: reel
pages.lead: Horizontal scroll with snap. Scrolling is the browser's; snap is CSS.

pages.title: frame
pages.lead: Hold an aspect ratio; crop media to fit. Uniform thumbnails from chaotic images.

pages.title: cover
pages.lead: Fill the viewport; center the principal element; pin the rest to the edges.

pages.title: button
pages.lead: The native element, styled directly. Variants and sizes are data attributes; behavior remains native.

pages.title: badge
pages.lead: Quiet metadata in a styled box. Informational, never a fake control.

pages.title: avatar
pages.lead: Initials or an image; optional deterministic color and features based on a string.

pages.title: skeleton
pages.lead: A quiet, composable placeholder for consumer-owned loading states.

pages.title: stat grid
pages.lead: Responsive name/value summaries using a native description list and explicit stat items.

pages.title: content
pages.lead: Tables, lists, code, quotes — prose-adjacent elements that just work.

pages.title: progress & meter
pages.lead: Thin square bars. Meter grades through the status roles — the browser decides which.

pages.title: input & textarea
pages.lead: One control family with buttons: same radius, border, and height.

pages.title: select
pages.lead: Custom picker where the platform allows (base-select); native picker elsewhere. Zero JS either way.

pages.title: checkbox
pages.lead: Drawn with appearance: none; semantics, keyboard, and forms stay native.

pages.title: radio
pages.lead: The square target: a solid pip in every state.

pages.title: segmented control
pages.lead: A native radio group fused into one compact control. No script, no reconstructed ARIA.

pages.title: switch
pages.lead: A native checkbox with switch semantics, wearing a track. Square, like everything else.

pages.title: fieldset
pages.lead: A titled group, not a bordered box. Disabling one silences everything inside.

pages.title: field validation
pages.lead: Declarative per-cause errors below the field. No browser bubbles.

pages.title: header navigation
pages.lead: A brand, ordinary navigation links, and optional actions. Add a small enhancement for a single-row mobile menu.

pages.title: navigation menu
pages.lead: Nested header navigation with compact dropdowns, richer link panels, and inline mobile disclosures.

pages.title: sidebar
pages.lead: Grouped navigation with docked and inset treatments. Optional icon collapse and a flush mobile dialog enhance authored markup.

pages.title: stepper
pages.lead: A compact previous, current, and next frame for any consumer-owned sequence.

pages.title: dialog
pages.lead: Modal and drawer. Focus trap, Esc, and top layer — the browser's. Open/close — invoker commands (shimmed while support spreads).

pages.title: accordion
pages.lead: details + summary. Exclusivity, keyboard, and semantics are the browser's — the shared name attribute does the grouping.

pages.title: popover & tooltip
pages.lead: popover attribute + popovertarget invokers. Toggle, light dismiss, Esc, top layer — the browser's. Zero JS.

pages.title: toast
pages.lead: A custom element around a native manual popover. Display, dismissal, and announcement are declarative; queueing and auto-dismiss are an opt-in JS enhancement.

pages.title: tabs
pages.lead: The one pattern the platform still can't do accessibly without script. m-tabs enhances working markup — it never renders it.

pages.title: combobox
pages.lead: A native datalist, upgraded. Without the module: functional autocomplete. With it: styled listbox, filtering, active-descendant keys.
